title: Wisdom's Call

questions.question: Does not wisdom call? Does not understanding raise her what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:1 (ESV): "Does not understanding raise her voice?"

questions.question: For my mouth will utter truth; wickedness is an abomination to my what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:7 (ESV): "wickedness is an abomination to my lips."

questions.question: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than choice what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:10 (ESV): "and knowledge rather than choice gold."

questions.question: The fear of the Lord is hatred of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:13 (ESV): "The fear of the Lord is hatred of evil."

questions.question: I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently find whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:17 (ESV): "and those who seek me diligently find me."

questions.question: For wisdom is better than what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:11 (ESV): "For wisdom is better than jewels,"

questions.question: I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, and I find knowledge and what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:12 (ESV): "and I find knowledge and discretion."

questions.question: By me kings reign, and rulers decree what is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:15 (ESV): "and rulers decree what is just;"

questions.question: Riches and honor are with me, enduring wealth and what?
My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold, and my yield than choice what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:19 (ESV): "and my yield than choice silver."

questions.question: The Lord possessed me at the beginning of his work, the first of his acts of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:22 (ESV): "the first of his acts of old."

questions.question: When he established the heavens, I was where?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:27 (ESV): "When he established the heavens, I was there;"

questions.question: Then I was beside him, like a master what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:30 (ESV): "then I was beside him, like a master workman,"

questions.question: Blessed is the one who listens to me, watching daily at my what?
For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 8:35 (ESV): "and obtains favor from the Lord."

key_verse_text: For wisdom is better than jewels, and all that you may desire cannot compare with her.
